title: notopterygium weberbauerianum
intro: Notopterygium weberbauerianum, commonly known as Qianghuo, is a traditional Chinese medicinal plant belonging to the Apiaceae family. Qianghuo is valued for its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties, and it has been used to treat various health conditions, including pain and fever. The therapeutic actions of Qianghuo include its ability to relieve pain, reduce inflammation, and improve circulation. The bioactive constituents of Qianghuo include volatile oils, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
